mentions.name: QuizFox
mentions.description: QuizFox is a daily trivia game app for iOS that serves Jeopardy-style trivia questions each day. It was built as a side project using AI-assisted development, including AI-written trivia questions that were reviewed and fixed for hallucination issues. Feedback is being gathered on onboarding, question quality, and the overall app experience.
